title: Filing status — six taxpayers
instructions: Select the most favorable filing status each taxpayer may use for 2025.

rows.label: Unmarried; her 4-year-old son lives with her all year and she pays all household costs
rows.explanation: A qualifying child lives with her and she pays over half the costs.

rows.label: Spouse died in 2024; not remarried; maintains a home for her dependent daughter
rows.explanation: Available for 2 years after the year of death with a dependent child.

rows.label: Married and living together all year; spouse refuses to file jointly
rows.explanation: Without consent, a joint return isn't possible.

rows.label: Divorced on December 20, 2025; no dependents
rows.explanation: Marital status is determined at year-end.

rows.label: Married; spouse moved out in March and they lived apart the rest of the year; she pays over half the cost of the home for her dependent son
rows.explanation: She's considered unmarried under the abandoned-spouse rules.

rows.label: Spouse died in October 2025; not remarried
rows.explanation: A joint return may be filed for the year of death.
